WORKBOOK 6-UNITNING TO'RTINChI (oxirgi) BETI (29-bet). Yuqorida o'ngda 'Food, Glorious Food' va to'q sariq '6'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Reading':
20a) 'Read the report and fill in although, firstly, secondly, finally, and however, then mark the sentences which follow as T (true) or F (false).' HISOBOT (kulrang qog'oz, Para 1-5): 'Introduction. The purpose of this report is to assess the new Blue Moon restaurant in Abbington's city centre, which I visited on 14th May. Food and Prices. The menu at the Blue Moon is rather boring for vegetarians as there are only a few salad and pasta dishes to choose from. 1) ......, there are plenty of delicious dishes for those who eat meat. I ordered the grilled chicken with Basmati rice. The chicken was very tasty, but the rice was rather cold. I also thought that the Blue Moon was rather expensive. Service. The staff at the Blue Moon were friendly and helpful. Even though my guest and I asked a lot of questions, our waiter remained polite and patiently explained many dishes to us. 2) ...... it was very busy on the night I visited the Blue Moon, the service was still fast. Atmosphere. The comfortable seating, lovely furnishings and live piano music helped to give the Blue Moon a relaxing atmosphere. The excellent food and service definitely made our evening pleasurable. Conclusion. The new Blue Moon restaurant in Abbington's city centre is, on the whole, a wonderful place to dine. However, I think the manager should make a few changes. 3) ......, she should have a wider selection of vegetarian dishes, so that all customers are satisfied. 4) ......, she should make sure that all hot dishes are served hot. 5) ......, she should lower the prices to give everyone a chance to visit this fabulous new restaurant.'
  T/F: 1 The menu is great for vegetarians. 2 The restaurant was rather expensive. 3 The staff were rude. 4 The restaurant is a wonderful place to dine.
20b) 'Read the report again and match the paragraphs to the paragraph descriptions.' a) good & bad points about food & prices; b) good & bad points about atmosphere; c) name of place, location, purpose of report; d) comments & suggestions; e) good & bad points about service.

O'NG USTUN - 'Writing (a report about the good and bad points of a place)':
21) 'Tim Davis visited the new Fontana's Pizza House in Sunford last week. Read his comments and fill in the table below. Use the completed table to write his report. Use the report in Ex. 20 as a model (120-160 words).' PUFAKLAR: 'The pizzas were tasty and they weren't expensive.' 'It was rather noisy - I think they should play quieter music.' 'The tables were clean and the furnishings were very modern.' 'The menu was rather boring - I think they should add some different dishes.' 'The service was slow - I think the manager should train staff to work faster.' 'The staff were very friendly.' JADVAL: Good Points / Bad Points & Suggestions: Food & Prices; Service; Atmosphere.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '29'.
⚠ Orqa tomondan (30-bet, 'Profiles') sarlavha ko'chib ko'rinadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Report on the Blue Moon restaurant: Introduction - Food and Prices - Service - Atmosphere - Conclusion.
exercises.instructionUz: Blue Moon restorani haqida hisobot: Kirish - Ovqat va narxlar - Xizmat - Muhit - Xulosa.
exercises.explanationUz:
HISOBOT (REPORT) - JOYNING YAXShI
  va YOMON TOMONLARI.

TUZILISh (5 xatboshi, SARLAVHALI):
  1 Introduction - nom, joy, maqsad
  2 Food and Prices - yaxshi/yomon
  3 Service - yaxshi/yomon
  4 Atmosphere - yaxshi/yomon
  5 Conclusion - izoh va takliflar
    (should)


⚠ RASMIY USLUB:

  'The purpose of this report is
  to assess ...' = hisobot maqsadi
  ... ni baholash.
  'on the whole' = umuman olganda.
  'rather' = ancha (yumshatadi).


⚠ BOG'LOVChILAR (20a):

  HOWEVER = ammo (yangi gap boshida,
    qarama-qarshilik)
  ALTHOUGH = garchi (gap ichida)
  FIRSTLY, SECONDLY, FINALLY =
    birinchidan, ikkinchidan,
    nihoyat (takliflar ro'yxati)


⚠ 'TO ASSESS':

  = baholamoq.


⚠ 'PLENTY OF':

  = ko'p, yetarlicha.


⚠ 'TO REMAIN POLITE':

  = odobli bo'lib qolmoq.


⚠ 'FURNISHINGS':

  = jihozlar, mebel.


⚠ 'PLEASURABLE':

  = yoqimli, zavqli.


⚠ 'TO DINE':

  = ovqatlanmoq (rasmiy).


⚠ 'TO LOWER THE PRICES':

  = narxlarni tushirmoq.


⚠ 'FABULOUS':

  = ajoyib.

points.en: Introduction: The purpose of this report is to assess the new Blue Moon restaurant in Abbington's city centre, which I visited on 14th May.
points.uz: Kirish: Ushbu hisobotning maqsadi - men 14-mayda tashrif buyurgan Abbington shahar markazidagi yangi Blue Moon restoranini baholash.
points.noteUz: ⚠ PARA 1 (c) - joy nomi, joylashuvi, hisobot maqsadi.

points.en: Food and Prices: The menu at the Blue Moon is rather boring for vegetarians as there are only a few salad and pasta dishes to choose from. However, there are plenty of delicious dishes for those who eat meat. I ordered the grilled chicken with Basmati rice. The chicken was very tasty, but the rice was rather cold. I also thought that the Blue Moon was rather expensive.
points.uz: Ovqat va narxlar: Blue Moon menyusi vegetarianlar uchun ancha zerikarli, chunki tanlash uchun faqat bir nechta salat va makaron taomlari bor. Ammo go'sht yeydiganlar uchun ko'plab mazali taomlar bor. Men Basmati guruchi bilan grilda pishirilgan tovuq buyurdim. Tovuq juda mazali edi, lekin guruch ancha sovuq edi. Shuningdek, Blue Moon ancha qimmat deb o'yladim.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 2 (a) - ovqat va narxlar: yaxshi (mazali taomlar) va yomon (vegetarianlar uchun kam, guruch sovuq, qimmat).
⚠ 1) HOWEVER - qarama-qarshilik.

points.en: Service: The staff at the Blue Moon were friendly and helpful. Even though my guest and I asked a lot of questions, our waiter remained polite and patiently explained many dishes to us. Although it was very busy on the night I visited the Blue Moon, the service was still fast.
points.uz: Xizmat: Blue Moon xodimlari samimiy va yordamchan edi. Mehmonim va men ko'p savol bersak ham, ofitsiantimiz odobli bo'lib qoldi va sabr bilan ko'p taomlarni tushuntirdi. Men borgan kechada juda gavjum bo'lsa ham, xizmat baribir tez edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 3 (e) - xizmat: yaxshi (samimiy, odobli, tez).
⚠ 2) ALTHOUGH - garchi (gap ichida).

points.en: Atmosphere: The comfortable seating, lovely furnishings and live piano music helped to give the Blue Moon a relaxing atmosphere. The excellent food and service definitely made our evening pleasurable.
points.uz: Muhit: Qulay o'rindiqlar, chiroyli jihozlar va jonli pianino musiqasi Blue Moonga xotirjam muhit berdi. A'lo ovqat va xizmat kechamizni albatta yoqimli qildi.

points.en: Conclusion: The new Blue Moon restaurant in Abbington's city centre is, on the whole, a wonderful place to dine. However, I think the manager should make a few changes. Firstly, she should have a wider selection of vegetarian dishes, so that all customers are satisfied. Secondly, she should make sure that all hot dishes are served hot. Finally, she should lower the prices to give everyone a chance to visit this fabulous new restaurant.
points.uz: Xulosa: Abbington shahar markazidagi yangi Blue Moon restorani, umuman olganda, ovqatlanish uchun ajoyib joy. Ammo menimcha, menejer bir nechta o'zgarish qilishi kerak. Birinchidan, barcha mijozlar qoniqishi uchun vegetarian taomlarining kengroq tanlovi bo'lishi kerak. Ikkinchidan, barcha issiq taomlar issiq holda berilishiga ishonch hosil qilishi kerak. Nihoyat, hammaga bu ajoyib yangi restoranga tashrif buyurish imkonini berish uchun narxlarni tushirishi kerak.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PARA 5 (d) - izoh va takliflar ('should').
⚠ 3) FIRSTLY, 4) SECONDLY, 5) FINALLY - takliflar tartibi.

  2 GARChI gavjum bo'lsa ham,

  3-5 uchta taklif → FIRSTLY,

⚠ HOWEVER vs ALTHOUGH:

  However, + gap. (alohida gap)
  Although + gap, gap. (bitta gap)

modelAnswers:
Introduction
The purpose of this report is to assess the new Fontana's Pizza House in Sunford, which I visited last week.

Food and Prices
The pizzas at Fontana's were very tasty and they weren't expensive. However, the menu was rather boring as there were only a few dishes to choose from.

Service
The staff were very friendly. Although they were polite and helpful, the service was rather slow and we had to wait a long time for our pizzas.

Atmosphere
The tables were clean and the furnishings were very modern. However, the restaurant was rather noisy because the music was too loud.

Conclusion
On the whole, Fontana's Pizza House is a nice place to eat. However, I think the manager should make a few changes. Firstly, he should add some different dishes to the menu. Secondly, he should train the staff to work faster. Finally, he should play quieter music.
